bundle.shortDescription: Free, simple virtual machine manager for Windows.
bundle.longDescription: Thomsen VM - a free, modern virtual machine manager for Windows. Create and run isolated virtual machines (Windows, Linux, and more) with a clean setup wizard, a live console, and snapshot management, powered by QEMU.
